items.unit: EUR/km (FTL, German domestic, spot, shipper-offered, Q2 2026 average)
items.basis: TIMOCOM Transportbarometer Q2 2026 (press release on presseportal.de, TIMOCOM newsroom 50246): German domestic average rate offered by shippers €2.10/km (+13.4% y/y); carrier-requested €2.18/km (+10.5% y/y); Europe-wide shipper average €1.81/km. Cross-check, same publisher: May 2026 shippers offered €2.19/km (>+17% y/y), carriers' weekly peak €2.36/km (KW 20); Q2 2025 €1.86 offered / €1.97 requested. Converted at the book FX: €2.10 × 0.858 = £1.80/km.
items.notes: Freight-exchange platform data (offers and asks on the TIMOCOM spot market) — SPOT, not contract; spot is usually above contract in a fuel-driven quarter. B2B freight prices are quoted net; the release (snippet) does not state VAT explicitly. Read from search snippets only: presseportal.de is blocked from this environment. The publisher was inferred from the presseportal newsroom id that the TIMOCOM search returned; re-read on the page before it sets a rate.

items.basis: IRU / Upply / Ti European Road Freight Rate Benchmark Q2 2026 as reported by trans.info / transport-online: Duisburg–Prague €1.73/km, Duisburg–Lille €2.58/km (contract). German domestic contract index 158.3 in June 2026 (+11.6 points q/q); German domestic spot +10.2 points q/q and the strongest y/y spot rise of the four domestic markets covered. The index is not convertible to €/km from the snippets.
items.notes: Benchmark (survey of contract rates), snippets only (trans.info and ti-insight.com are blocked here). DE-origin cross-border lanes, not German domestic; reference only. Second source for the lanes: https://transport-online.de/en/news/iru-analysis-europe-s-freight-rates-are-likely-rise-significantly-again-188397.html

items.unit: EUR/km (Lkw-Maut, > 18 t, ≥ 5 axles, Euro VI, CO2 emission class 1; total of infrastructure + air pollution + noise + CO2 part-rates)
items.basis: Toll Collect tariff table as reproduced by autobahn-baustellen.de: 34.8 ct/km for Euro 6, CO2 class 1, > 18 t, 5+ axles ('Gesamtmautsatz inkl. aller Teilsätze'); 32.4 ct/km 4 axles; 30.3 ct/km up to 3 axles; table 'gültig seit 01.07.2024', stated valid for 2026. The CO2 part-rate for this class is 15.8 ct/km (BGL statement table, from the 2023 draft that became BFStrMG Anlage 1, BGBl. 2023 I Nr. 315; CO2 charge at €200/t CO2 since 1 Dec 2023). 0.348 × 0.858 = £0.299/km.
items.date: rates in force since 2024-07-01; no change for 2026 found
items.notes: Statute (BFStrMG Anlage 1, https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/bfstrmg/anlage_1.html — last amended 23 Feb 2026 per lxgesetze.de header) read via a secondary site: gesetze-im-internet.de and toll-collect.de are blocked here, so the statutory table itself was not read. A second secondary table (bussgeldrechner.org) gives 34.0 ct/km for the same class — the CO2 class it assumes is unclear. A public charge, no VAT. Applies on Autobahnen and Bundesstraßen; trucks > 3.5 t since 1 Jul 2024. A Euro VI truck in a better CO2 class (2–5) pays less.
